messages:
maria: Quick unblock pls — PR #3245 needs one more ok before the merge window closes in ~45m. It's a tiny rename + gofumpt reformat. CI hit a flaky integration test earlier, not sure if rerun will clear it. anyone around to give the final LGTM or kick CI?

sam: I can watch and merge once CI is green. ping me when you rerun. :thumbsup:

jin: which test flaked? if it's TestKVCacheRace I can look, but if it's just fmt changes we should be fine to rerun.

maria: failure excerpt from the job: ```
=== RUN   TestKVCacheRace
--- FAIL: TestKVCacheRace (0.12s)
    kvcache_test.go:142: expected no data race, got concurrent map read/write
```

lara: that looks like a transient CI race. For this PR I'd prefer not to fold a formatter-only change with any actual behavioral change — if you can split the gofumpt bits into a separate commit it keeps blame clean. but given the window, rerun is fine.

maria: split is mostly done in my local branch, but rebasing will take a few mins. if someone can rerun in the meantime that’d speed things up. @sam?

devops-bot: CI rerun requested by @sam for job red/3245. Rebuild queued (estimated start ~1m).

sam: kicked it. watching logs.

(devops-bot): job red/3245: all checks passed ✅

sam: CI green, I gave an LGTM and landed the PR to main. thanks y'all. :rocket:

maria: awesome — thanks for the quick help. I'll open a tiny follow-up to split the fmt commit tomorrow (no rush).

lara: thanks, appreciated. saves future blame noise.

jin: nice, thanks sam.
